# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 26 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Latin MS (Vita Adae et Evae) | **Section:** Adam Tells His Children of His Illness

---

**1** Adam summoned all his children: 'Sons and daughters, listen to me. I am sick and suffering.'

**2** 'For many years I have been toiling on the earth since the day I was driven from paradise with your mother.'

**3** 'But now my strength is gone and my death is upon me.'

---
*PNEUMA: modern English; verse-only numbering.*
